Get Power (Check card0 then card1) powerPath := "/sys/class/drm/card0/device/hwmon/hwmon0/power1_input" if _, err :=

os.Stat(powerPath); os.IsNotExist(err) { powerPath = "/sys/class/drm/card1/device/hwmon/hwmon1/power1_input" } if data, err := os.ReadFile(powerPath); err == nil { pMicrowatts, _ := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(string(data))) stats.Power = fmt.Sprintf("%.1fW", float64(pMicrowatts)/1000000.0) } // 2. Get VRAM Usage vramUsedPath := "/sys/class/drm/card0/device/mem_info_vram_used" vramTotalPath := "/sys/class/drm/card0/device/mem_info_vram_total" usedData, errU := os.ReadFile(vramUsedPath) totalData, errT := os.ReadFile(vramTotalPath) if errU == nil && errT == nil {; used, _ := strconv.ParseFloat(strings.TrimSpace(string(usedData)), 64) total, _ := strconv.ParseFloat(strings.TrimSpace(string(totalData)), 64) // Convert Bytes to GiB (1024^3) stats.MemoryUsed = fmt.Sprintf("%.1f / %.1f GiB", used/1073741824, total/1073741824) } return stats } func main() { // 1. Telemetry API Endpoint http.HandleFunc("/api/telemetry", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { stats := getArcTelemetry() json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(stats) }) // 2. Simple Chat Proxy to Ollama http.HandleFunc("/api/chat", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { // Insert your existing Ollama proxy logic here... // Ensure you pass through the 'stream: true' response! }) // 3.
